component.name: LensScan
component.summary: Scan documents with a CZUR Lens document camera
Numériser des documents avec une caméra de documents CZUR Lens

description.p: LensScan is scanning software for CZUR Lens document cameras: live preview, automatic page cropping and straightening, curved book flattening, color modes, batch page tools, export to PDF, TIFF, PNG, JPEG and BMP, text recognition (Tesseract) to searchable PDF, Word, Excel and text, and a presentation mode with drawing, video and screen recording.
Not affiliated with or endorsed by CZUR Tech Co., Ltd.
